summary_en: AVAL DATA will tender all 800,000 shares of E-SOL (code 4420) held as policy holdings in a public tender offer by BCJ-110 at 820 yen per share, expected to generate approximately 596 million yen in investment securities gain in the fiscal year ending March 2027.
summary_jp: 公開買付者BCJ-110によるイーソル株式会社の公開買付けに対し、政策保有していた80万株の全てを応募。買付価格は1株当たり820円で、2027年3月期に約5億9,600万円の投資有価証券売却益を計上する見込み。

summary_en: 353,700 ordinary shares to be cancelled (5.9% of shares outstanding), effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 6,014,142; treasury shares: 180,739.
